messages:
Priya: quick heads-up — I opened a few small PRs that need reviewers: migration guide for streaming endpoints, a python async SDK snippet add, and a couple of linkfixes. <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234|PR#1234>
Luca: pinged. I can take the examples/snippet one. is it just adding an async example or migrating existing ones?
Priya: just adding an async snippet and a short note about backpressure. should be ~6 lines. also the migration guide touches the streaming table of contents — needs eyes on structure.
Ava: I’ll grab the migration guide, I know the streaming section. ETA tonight.
Tom: I can handle the link fixes and run linkcheck locally. which pages are failing?
Priya: linkcheck flagged two relative links in streaming/migrate.md and one external SSO doc that redirects. CI preview is currently failing on render of the code block (layout overflow) for the migration guide.
docs-ci-bot: Preview build started for PR#1234 — build id 9876. Linkcheck: 3 failures. Preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/1234/build/9876
Luca: saw preview — code fence overflow on mobile. quick fix might be to break long inline command into multiple lines or use a collapsed block.
Ava: taking a look now, if I push a small formatting fix can you re-run preview?
Priya: yes please push and tag me. plan is to merge after green CI and during low traffic window — tonight 23:00 PT. can we keep that handoff explicit?
Tom: will open a tiny PR (#1235) for link fixes referencing this thread and let docs-ci run.
Nora: I’m the on-call reviewer for docs rotation tonight — if anyone needs a quick unblock after 22:30 PT ping me and I’ll merge once CI is green.
Luca: thanks @Nora — I’ll make sure tests/preview are green before requesting. :thumbsup:
Ava: pushed formatting tweak and a brief note in the migration guide. comment in PR with rationale.
docs-ci-bot: Preview build finished for PR#1234 — build id 9877. Linkcheck: 0 failures. Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/1234/build/9877
Priya: perfect. @Luca @Tom @Ava please add an explicit reviewer approval when ready. Merge window still 23:00 PT.
Luca: approved.
Tom: approved, will merge around 23:05 PT unless someone needs earlier.
Ava: approved, leaving final copy notes in the PR thread.
Priya: thanks all. leaving one follow-up to add a tiny example in the SDK README later — created a placeholder issue. :party_parrot:
